title: pvPLOT3DReader
body:
## pvPLOT3DReader

Reads NASA PLOT3D structured-grid data: a grid file (.xyz) with block coordinates, solution files (.q) holding density, momentum and stagnation energy, and a function file (.f) of extra variables. The output is a multiblock dataset of structured grids with density, momentum and stagnation energy as point arrays; Functions adds derived quantities (pressure, Mach number, velocity, vorticity …) computed with the reader's gas constants R = 1.0 and γ = 1.4, which are not exposed here. Several .q files form a time series. Use pvPLOT3DMetaFileReader when a .p3d meta file describes the case.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- PLOT3D files are not self-describing: when AutoDetectFormat (ParaView default true) cannot work, e.g. for ASCII files, set BinaryFile, ByteOrder, DoublePrecision, MultiGrid, HasByteCount, IBlanking and TwoDimensionalGeometry to match the writer.
- FunctionFileName and QFileName are optional: leave them out to read the grid file alone. The native reader skips an empty solution or function file name, so a grid-only case is valid and produces no solution arrays.
- Check that R = 1.0 and γ = 1.4 match your solver's normalization before interpreting derived pressure, temperature or Mach number.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `PLOT3DReader`. Identity: `sources/P3DReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AutoDetectFormat` | When this options is enabled, the reader will try to automatically figure out various settings for a binary file. The other options are ignored. Does not work for text (ASCII) files. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `BinaryFile` | This property indicates whether the data files are binary. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ByteOrder` | This property specifies the byte order of any binary file(s). | `{"type":"enum","values":["BigEndian","LittleEndian"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"BigEndian"` |
| `DoublePrecision` | This property specifies whether floating points values are in double precision. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the .xyz (geometry) file name for the PLOT3D reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ForceRead` | This property indicates whether to attempt to read the file even if it appears corrupt | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FunctionFileName` | Optional path of the PLOT3D function file (.f) holding extra per-point variables. Leave it out when there is none; the native reader skips an empty function file name. Relative paths are resolved from the working directory of the Schemaxis process (in Studio, the directory it was launched from), not from the JSON file's folder. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Functions` | This property lists which functions (point-centered arrays) to compute. | `{"items":{"type":"enum","values":["Scalar - Pressure","Scalar - Pressure Coefficient","Scalar - Mach Number","Scalar - Sound Speed","Scalar - Temperature","Scalar - Enthalpy","Scalar - Internal energy","Scalar - Kinetic energy","Scalar - Velocity magnitude","Scalar - Entropy","Scalar - Swirl","Vector - Velocity","Vector - Vorticity","Vector - Pressure gradient","Scalar - Vorticity magnitude","Vector - Strain rate"]},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["Scalar - Pressure"]` |
| `HasByteCount` | This property indicates whether this file uses Fortran leading-trailing byte counts. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `IBlanking` | This property indicates whether this dataset has visibility information. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MultiGrid` | This property indicates whether these files have multiple-block information. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `PreserveIntermediateFunctions` | When checked, the reader will preserve intermediate computed quantities that were not explicitly requested e.g. if **Velocity magnitude** is enabled, but not **Velocity**, the reader still needs to compute **Velocity**. If this is unchecked, then the output will not have **Velocity** array, only the requested **VelocityMagnitude**. This is useful to avoid using up memory for arrays that are not relevant for the analysis. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `QFileName` | The list of .q (solution) files for the PLOT3D reader. There can be more than one. If more that one file is specified, the reader will switch to file-series mode in which it will pretend that it can support time and provide one file per time step. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `TwoDimensionalGeometry` | This property indicates whether the data is two- or three-dimensional. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvPLOT3DReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
